message.content:
Based on my search, here are the main ways to pay your federal taxes online:

## 1. IRS Direct Pay (Free)
The simplest and most popular option for individual taxpayers. You can pay directly from your checking or savings account with **no fees**.
- Website: [directpay.irs.gov](https://directpay.irs.gov)
- No registration required – you can use guest access
- Schedule payments up to 365 days in advance
- Same-day payment available
- You can modify or cancel up to 2 business days before the scheduled date

## 2. IRS Online Account
A free option that gives you more features than Direct Pay:
- View your balance, payment history, and tax records
- Make payments via ACH bank transfer
- Set up payment plans
- Requires identity verification to create an account

## 3. Debit or Credit Card (Fees Apply)
Pay through IRS-authorized third-party processors:
- **Pay1040**: Credit card fee 1.75% (min $2.50); Debit card $2.15 flat
- **ACI Payments**: Credit card fee 1.85% (min $2.50); Debit card $2.10 flat
- Available online or by phone
- Also supports digital wallets like Venmo, PayPal, and Click to Pay

## 4. Electronic Funds Withdrawal (EFW)
Available when you e-file your taxes using tax preparation software, a tax professional, or IRS Free File. The payment is automatically debited from your bank account when you file.

## 5. IRS2Go Mobile App
The IRS official mobile app lets you:
- Make Direct Pay payments for free
- Pay by debit/credit card (with processor fees)
- Check refund status and find free tax help

## Important Recent Change
As of **October 17, 2025**, the **Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS) stopped accepting new individual enrollments**. Existing users can still use it, but new individual taxpayers should use IRS Direct Pay or IRS Online Account instead. EFTPS remains available for businesses and federal agencies.

## New Electronic Payment Mandate
An Executive Order signed March 25, 2025 requires federal tax payments to be made electronically starting **September 30, 2025**. Paper checks and money orders will no longer be accepted after that date (with limited exceptions for those without banking access or in emergency situations).

## Steps to Pay Online with Direct Pay:
1. Go to [directpay.irs.gov](https://directpay.irs.gov)
2. Enter your SSN/ITIN, filing status, and address from your most recent tax return
3. Select your payment reason and tax form
4. Enter payment amount and date
5. Provide your bank routing and account number
6. Review and submit – save your confirmation number

---

Sources:
1. https://turbotax.intuit.com/tax-tips/tax-payments/how-to-pay-taxes-10-ways-to-pay-your-tax-bill/L6CR274jr
2. https://fiscal.treasury.gov/payments-to-government/electronic-federal-tax-payment-system-eftps
3. https://www.taxesforexpats.com/articles/expat-tax-rules/how-to-pay-taxes-online.html
4. https://www.nerdwallet.com/taxes/learn/pay-irs-options
5. https://www.zinnerco.com/zinner-blog/executive-order-requires-electronic-payment-of-federal-tax
6. https://www.taxbuddy.com/blog/advance-tax-payment-online
7. https://www.linkedin.com/posts/nasir-ahmed-922b342a5_usa-payroll-tax-payment-to-irs-using-quickbooks-activity-7265717672586153986-KKR3
8. https://www.tax1099.com/irs/irs-federal-tax-payment/
